topic: Design and preparation of PCB layout for a given circuit
syllabus_extract: Design and preparation of PCB layout for a given circuit.
specific_objectives: 24.12.1.1 Trainee will be able to design and prepare a PCB layout for a given circuit.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

intro_questions: What is the primary function of a PCB layout?
List three critical factors affecting PCB trace width.
Why is component placement important before routing?

development.content:
Circuit schematic analysis
Component footprint selection
Component placement strategy
Trace width and spacing rules
Via placement and routing

Importing schematic to layout tool
Placing components and orienting
Routing power and ground nets
Routing signal nets
Design rule check (DRC) verification

Final layout review and cleanup
Generating Gerber files
Exporting drill files
Documentation of design notes
Preparation for fabrication

summary_questions: Explain the relationship between trace width and current carrying capacity.
Describe the steps taken to ensure the layout meets design rules.
How does proper component placement affect signal integrity?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the design constraints encountered during the layout and propose solutions for future designs, bridging to LP 02 soldering techniques.

pft_rows.syllabus: Demonstration of Soldering and de-soldering techniques adopted on PCBs and cables. Safety precautions to be observed while Soldering and De-soldering on PCBs and cables.
